row.title: Case study page and agent directory packets
row.body: site/casestudy.js builds /proof/customer-zero from facts() only, each value carrying the snapshot path it was read from; a test fails on any number outside a fact cell. scripts/agent_directories.py writes one packet per directory from outreach/agent-directories.json and holds every submission while outreach/gate.json is dry-run; form and pull-request routes are never submitted by an agent. seed/scripts/outreach.py must stay byte-identical to scripts/outreach.py.
